en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a monumental equestrian statue on a high pedestal, surrounded by four standing figures in armor. The central rider is depicted in medieval attire on a horse, forming a dramatic silhouette against the sky. In the background there is a historic building with a pitched roof and windows, and some trees. Low flowerbeds encircle the monument, and a child can be seen near the base. The title text is printed at the top of the image.
